text: Pillar two's target state was one identity plane instead of two. This lesson is the real sequence Mara runs to get there, federating AWS IAM Identity Center to Entra ID.

First, she enables IAM Identity Center and configures SAML federation with Entra ID as the identity provider. Second, she turns on SCIM provisioning, so every Entra ID group membership change automatically provisions or deprovisions the matching AWS access, closing the drift gap Lesson 3 found. Third, she maps permission sets to Entra ID groups instead of individuals.

The permission set behind this pilot, Scada OT Administrator, is scoped to the Hartwell OT Analytics account and assigned to the Entra ID group SCADA-OT-Admins. Add someone to that group and SCIM grants them AWS access automatically. Remove them, and it's revoked just as automatically on the next sync.

This also lets Mara retire the long-lived AWS access keys Lesson 3 flagged, migrating those users to short-lived federated sessions and deleting the standing keys. Workload identities stay outside this consolidation on purpose. Next lesson rolls out pillar one's network segmentation plan, starting in monitor-only mode.
